<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
I've informed Brad about the suitable time and my intention to book it. Now I need to actually create the booking in the system. The agreed-upon time is Thursday at 14:30. The `create_booking` function takes the day and start time as parameters. So I'll call it with 'Thu' and '14:30'. After this, I'll notify Brad that the booking has been made so he can proceed with sending the confirmation email.
